多智能体系统

[MA-0] Proof-Carrying Contracts: Commitments AI Agents Cannot Break

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在由人工智能代理（AI agents）构成的协作经济中，如何确保代理在执行任务时严格遵守各方预先约定的约束条件（如政策、协议或指令），而无需依赖对对方代理的信任或逐项审查的问题。传统文本形式的协议无法保证代理在实际交互中始终合规，因其可能因误解、误读或自身利益驱动而偏离预期行为，从而引发安全与可靠性风险。为此，论文提出**可携带证明的合约（Proof-Carrying Contracts, PC2）**框架，其核心在于将合约中的约束条件转化为机器可验证的逻辑证明。在任何操作被执行前，代理必须提供一个形式化证明，表明其决策在所有可能的情境下均能保持合约所规定的约束不变。系统通过名为“Airlock”的执行环境对证明进行自动化检查，并据此决定是否授权操作。该机制使合约制定者仅需定义需保护的状态条件，而代理则自主选择策略并提供相应的推理依据，无需额外设计独立的权限策略，也避免了对每个决策逐一进行安全性验证的复杂性。论文证明，在整个执行过程中，即使面对恶意代理，约束条件依然被严格维持；并进一步分析了此类形式化保证在现实世界中蕴含的安全性意义。此外，可复用的能力模块为合约构建提供了标准化工具与形式化保障，从而为一个既保护委托方又保障执行方权益的可信代理经济体系奠定了基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28484
作者: Carlo Ciliberto,Alessandro Rudi,Enrico Tassi
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Logic in Computer Science (cs.LO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注: 70 pages, 8 Figures,

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI agents increasingly act on behalf of people or other agents, purchasing services, exchanging information and delegating work. What an agent must respect is written in instructions, policies or agreements, but text alone cannot make it comply. It may make mistakes, be redirected by what it reads, or pursue different interests. For an economy of such agents to function, parties need agreements they can rely on without inspecting or trusting one another’s agents. We introduce Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2), a framework for making agreed constraints enforceable throughout an agent’s interactions with a system. Before a requested operation can run, the agent must supply a machine-checkable proof that it preserves the agreed constraints in every case allowed by its model. An execution system called the Airlock checks the proof and controls access to the operation. The parties specify the conditions to preserve, while the agent supplies the reasoning needed to justify its decisions and remains free to adapt its strategy. This avoids having to design a separate permission policy and prove that every decision it permits is safe. We prove that the constraints hold at every instant during execution, even for an adversarial agent, and identify when this implies safety in the world. Reusable capability modules provide tools and guarantees from which contracts can be constructed. PC2 provides a foundation for an agent economy whose agreements protect both those delegating work and those carrying it out.

[MA-1] Claims of emergence in AI should be grounded in information decomposition NEURIPS

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前人工智能（AI）研究中对“协同效应”或“涌现”现象缺乏统一、可操作的理论框架这一核心问题。现有研究常以非正式方式描述多智能体系统、语言模型或人机协作中出现的超越个体能力的现象，但这些判断因缺乏量化标准而难以验证或比较。其解决方案的关键在于引入信息分解（information decomposition）作为统一的数学框架，将信息划分为三类：个体组件独有的信息、多个组件间冗余共享的信息，以及仅在各部分共同作用下才能获取的协同信息（synergistic information）。该框架为“涌现”提供了明确且可证伪的判定标准——只有当系统行为携带关于任务结果的协同信息时，才可被视为真正涌现。通过应用于注意力头、自主代理及人机团队，该方法不仅整合了跨尺度与跨底物的研究成果，还揭示出单一领域研究可能忽视的跨层次因果机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28479
作者: Christoph Riedl,Fernando E. Rosas
机构: Khoury College of Computer Sciences (凯瑟琳计算机科学学院); Northeastern University (东北大学); Department of Informatics (信息学系); University of Sussex (萨塞克斯大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Information Theory (cs.IT); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: NeurIPS Spotlight Paper

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a language model develops capabilities not traceable to its individual components, when a multi-agent AI system outperforms each agent on its own, or when a human-AI pair succeeds where either fails in isolation, AI researchers describe it as a case of synergy'' or emergence’'. However, these are usually informal assessments not supported by a theoretical framework, making these claims impossible to compare or even meaningfully dispute. Here we argue that \emphinformation decomposition can serve as a unifying formal framework to operationalize assessments about synergy in AI systems. Information decomposition provides a way to distinguish qualitatively different \emphtypes of information, including unique information available from individual components, redundant information shared across multiple components, and synergistic information accessible only from parts taken together. This gives claims of emergence a precise, falsifiable criterion: a system’s behavior is emergent only if it carries synergistic information about task-relevant outcomes. We apply this lens to attention heads, autonomous agents, and human-AI teams, showing how it organizes existing knowledge across scales and substrates, while also generating cross-level conjectures that siloed fields would miss.

[MA-2] oolflation: Seller Agents Distort Tool Markets Through Spontaneous Generative Engine Optimization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在多代理系统中，当销售代理（seller agents）为提升自身被选中概率而自主进行“生成式引擎优化”时，所引发的市场失真问题。其核心挑战在于：销售代理通过夸大自身工具的能力（如声称可处理更多任务领域），即使这些声明与实际性能不符，从而扭曲了买家代理（buyer agents）的选择机制，导致市场效率下降。解决方案的关键在于识别并定义这一现象——即“工具通胀”（toolflation），并揭示其在缺乏外部约束机制下的自我强化特性。研究基于亚马逊（Amazon）和Instagram的真实工具数据构建工具市场，对每种工具在所有问题上的表现进行全量评估，发现五种生产模型中均有销售代理不断扩展其功能宣称范围，甚至包括自身能力不足的领域；在部分模型下，这种行为导致工具描述趋同、失去区分度，买家仅依据位置选择工具，最终使任务成功率从近90%骤降至约30%，接近随机选择水平。这表明，在竞争环境下，对第三方保持诚实应被视为安全对齐（safety alignment）的重要组成部分，因此论文主张在部署前必须对模型作为销售者的角色进行独立测试，以防范此类系统性风险。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28454
作者: Zhenwei Tang,Di Bai,Jintao Liu,Xidong Wu,Qianfeng Wen,Xinwu Cheng
机构: Google(谷歌); University of Toronto (多伦多大学); Google DeepMind(谷歌深度思维)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 24 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Code: this https URL . Data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agents are starting to sell to other agents. Seller agents write the listings of tools, services and products, and buyer agents read these listings when they choose what to use. We show that seller agents told only to be selected more often practice generative engine optimization on their own, and that this distorts the market for sellers and for buyers. We build tool markets from real data tools on Amazon and Instagram and run every tool on every question, so we know which tools can answer each question. Under all five production models we test, sellers rewrite their descriptions to claim more and more fields, including fields that their tools return for fewer than half of the targets. We call this process toolflation. Nothing in the market limits it, and how far it goes depends on the model, as the number of claims that contradict the sellers’ own evidence differs by an order of magnitude between models. Toolflation shifts the buyers’ choices between sellers, and the most capable tool loses share in seven of the ten combinations of seller model and platform. Under four models, the choices stay with capable tools and buyer agents keep their task success. Under the fifth, sellers copy one another until the descriptions no longer tell the tools apart. Buyer agents then pick tools by their position in the list, tools that answer almost nothing win a quarter to two fifths of the choices, and task success falls from 89% to about 30% on Amazon, close to random choice, and from 77% to 40% on Instagram. The sellers did only what their vendors asked, and the cost fell on buyers they never dealt with. We therefore argue that honesty toward third parties under competition is part of safety alignment, and that models should be tested as sellers before they are deployed as sellers.

[MA-3] Local Work Global Progress: A Convergence Theory of AI Agent Collaboration

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体团队在执行复杂任务时，协作机制多依赖经验设计而缺乏收敛性保障的问题。其核心解决方案是将协同问题求解形式化为块优化（block optimization）：每个智能体在其负责的解空间局部改进方案，同时依据自身局部目标及对其他部分影响的修正项进行调整；由协调者（coordinator）评估每项提议是否符合全局目标，并合并互不冲突的提议。当修正项精确时，可证明线性收敛至一个误差下界；若存在干扰，则可在验证组合可行性后合并，此时收敛速率取决于实际组合效果而非最坏情况下的交互。实验表明，在机器人路径规划任务中，三智能体团队均能生成无碰撞路径，性能优于单个全控智能体；六智能体团队在更大规模任务中搜索速度约为单智能体的两倍，且通过选择经验证的最佳组合而非仅非冲突提案，进一步缩短约30%搜索时间。基于实际运行数据设定常数后，理论收敛边界在每轮迭代中均成立，与观测进展高度一致。该方法在SQLite查询计划与合成任务上亦得到验证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28286
作者: Ivan Ilin,Peter Richtárik
机构: KAUST(沙特国王科技大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注: 59 pages, 15 figures, 28 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Teams of large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to complex tasks, but their collaboration protocols are mostly designed empirically, without convergence guarantees. We formalize collaborative problem solving as block optimization: each agent improves one part of a shared solution, guided by its local objective plus a correction for how its changes affect the other parts. A coordinator checks every proposal against the global objective and merges proposals that do not interfere with each other. We prove linear convergence up to an error floor that vanishes when the corrections are exact. Interfering proposals can also be merged once their combination has been checked; the rate then depends on how well the proposals actually combine, not on worst-case interactions. With GPT-OSS-120B agents on robot routing, a three-agent team finds collision-free plans in every run, better than those of a single agent that controls all robots. On a larger routing task, a six-agent team completes its search about twice as fast as the single agent (in median). Merging the best checked combination of proposals, rather than only proposals that do not interfere, cuts the team’s search time by about 30%. With constants measured on the runs, our convergence bound holds in every round and follows the observed progress. We also test the theory on query planning in SQLite and on a synthetic task.

[MA-4] Safe Multi-Robot Collaboration With Uniform Exclusion Using Trust

【速读】：该论文旨在解决机器人集群在存在潜在恶意通信链路（即被攻陷的链路，可传输任意恶意数据）的情况下，如何实现安全且高效的协同决策问题。其核心挑战在于，在不依赖强假设（如网络连通性结构或受控攻击数量）的前提下，动态识别并排除受损链路，同时快速建立对合法链路的信任，以保障任务的安全性与性能。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为“Safe Wrapper”的通用通信封装算法，该算法通过集成基于异常检测器生成的实时可信度流（trust values），利用安全的即时有效推断（Safe Anytime-Valid Inference） 方法，持续筛选出高置信度的可靠通信链路。该方法仅要求异常检测器性能优于随机猜测，即可在任意时刻提供双重统计保障：一是以用户可指定的高概率始终排除所有被攻陷的链路（全局安全性），二是迅速学习并信任真实的合法链路（高效性）。这一机制在真实硬件平台上验证了其有效性，分别应用于3个LoCoBots的神经隐式建图和8个GoPiGos的方向共识任务，并通过基于实测数据的仿真证明其可扩展至数百机器人的规模。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28251
作者: Thomas Kaminsky,Áron Vékássy,Hammad Izhar,Angelia Nedić,Stephanie Gil
机构: Harvard University (哈佛大学); Arizona State University (亚利桑那州立大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 44 pages (30 main text + 14 supplementary); 10 figures, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Robot swarms coordinate through directed, time-varying local communication links, some of which may be compromised to allow the transmission of arbitrary malicious data. We provide an algorithm that acts as a wrapper around robot communication—when a robot seeks to update its state using data from some incoming links, our wrapper provides a subset of trusted links whose data can be safely incorporated. It selects these links by testing a stream of trust values—data collected from an anomaly detector on each robot—using Safe Anytime-Valid Inference. We require only that the detector be better than chance. This wrapper ensures safe and performant autonomy by providing two powerful statistical guarantees: it uniformly excludes all compromised links for all time with high user-chosen probability, but nevertheless quickly learns to trust legitimate links. Both guarantees are vital to secure generic tasks, but no previous work provides them simultaneously without restrictive assumptions on connectivity structure or the number of compromised links that are not guaranteed in practice. We study our Safe Wrapper’s performance in hardware for two contrasting tasks—neural implicit mapping and heading consensus—deploying on 3 LoCoBots and 8 GoPiGos, respectively. We provide simulations using trust values sampled from hardware to validate that our approach scales well to swarms of hundreds of robots.

[MA-5] S2-MAS: A Society-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation Framework with 500 Million Household Persona Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模社会经济模拟中个体决策行为与家庭实际状况及历史行为动态耦合的问题，即如何在社会尺度上构建能够真实反映家庭微观特征及其决策演化路径的多主体仿真框架。其解决方案的关键在于提出S²-MAS框架，通过基于5亿个基于真实调查数据生成的合成家庭人物（synthetic household personas）实现高保真度的社会规模模拟；引入Genese引擎将决策过程与状态更新解耦，提升模型灵活性；结合可复用的金融情景与应用账本，精确追踪消费、现金流、债务与支付等关键变量；并采用经过293万样本监督微调（SFT）与强化学习对比训练（RLCD）的紧凑型决策模型FinL-mlx，实现了74.55%的决策准确率和38.37%的问题-宏观F1值，在多个消费者金融选择任务中优于Jev 1.13与GLM-5.3-Flash。该框架支持对1200万不同家庭代理在配对购买融资条件下的模拟，揭示了收入、年龄、教育、就业及家庭结构差异对消费、债务偿还与现金提取行为的影响机制，并通过24个月面板数据验证了信用额度与购买目标变化对后续信贷供给的动态反馈效应，从而实现了从异质性家庭决策到演化消费、现金流与还款路径的精准映射。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27746
作者: Yang Li,Di Wan,Yike Wang,Chujun He,Zongsi Xu,Xiyu Chen,Sheng Zhong,Deng Binjie,Zhenwei Guo,Hou Jun,Kunhan Guo,Weihao Lin,Tuo Zhou,Hai Liu,Ye Luo
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 58 pages, 13 main figures, 7 supplementary figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances and the effects of earlier actions. We introduce S ^2 -MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework built on 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data. Its Genese engine separates decisions from state updates, while reusable financial scenarios and application ledgers track consumption, cash, debt and payments. FinL-mlx, a compact decision model trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 in consumer financial-choice scenarios, outperforming Jev 1.13 and GLM-5.3-Flash on both measures. We evaluate eight financial task families and simulate 12 million distinct household agents in paired purchase-funding conditions. Jointly raising purchase goals and approved credit limits increases consumption, with responses differing across age and income groups. Education, employment and household-size differences persist after age–income standardization and mainly reflect transitions from deferral to purchase. Asset and debt groups differ in cash drawdown, repayment and closing debt. A 24-month panel varies purchase goals under a common credit product, with repayment and arrears updating subsequent offers. S ^2 -MAS links heterogeneous household decisions to evolving consumption, cash and repayment paths, supporting economic experiments across household groups, population scales and time horizons.

[MA-6] Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Pay When Agents Agent s Serve Users? Testing Agent Scaling in Dual-Control Settings

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-agent System, MAS）在实际应用中是否真正优于单智能体系统（Single-agent System, SAS）这一关键问题，尤其聚焦于在与用户交互的现实场景下，MAS能否带来可衡量的性能提升。现有研究提出“能力饱和规则”：当SAS能力较弱时，协作能提升表现；但当SAS能力较强时，多智能体协作反而会拖累性能，转折点约在45%的单智能体准确率处。然而，该规则基于自主基准测试得出，未考虑用户参与的真实交互环境。本文在τ²-基准（τ²-bench）上进行验证，该基准模拟真实世界中的双控场景（如航空、零售、电信服务），要求智能体在用户指令和书面策略约束下协同工作。研究对来自三个模型家族的六种模型，在约7,950次模拟对话中对比了标准SAS与集中式MAS的表现，采用每轮对话仅一次完成令牌（completion-token）记录的严格评估方式。结果表明，在固定模拟用户条件下，所有有效测试单元中均未观察到MAS的优势：13个有效单元中有12个MAS表现更差，1个持平，整体加权平均得分下降28分（95%置信区间[-44, -12]），且其收益在预测应有优势的两个单元中仍分别落后13和22分；即使取消预算上限，其最优表现也需消耗5.5倍于SAS的计算资源才能勉强持平。此外，尽管MAS未能显著减少错误数据库写入，反而将其他失败形式转化为预算耗尽或行动停滞。研究还指出，当前MAS架构存在一个关键缺陷——其规划器从未接触过工具模式（tool schemas），导致其决策缺乏必要信息支持。因此，该研究的核心结论是：对于面向人类的服务型智能体，若无在真实应用场景中以计算成本匹配为前提的直接证据，不应默认多智能体设计优于单智能体方案。研究全程预注册并公开全部轨迹、日志、提示词与代码，确保可复现性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27655
作者: Ethan Yang,Xiangcheng Shi
机构: University of Pennsylvania(宾夕法尼亚大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems (MAS) built from language models are deployed on the premise that collaboration beats a single-agent system (SAS), yet when it pays is unclear. The most systematic study to date gives a capability-saturation rule: coordination helps while the SAS is weak and hurts once it is strong, with the crossing near 45% single-agent accuracy. That rule was derived on autonomous benchmarks, where no user takes part. We test it where agents now work: in conversation with a user under a written policy, on \tau^2 -bench, the dual-control benchmark. On its airline, retail and telecom domains we compare the stock SAS with a centralized MAS built from the same model for six models from three families, over about 7,950 simulated conversations, with one completion-token ledger per episode per system. The study was pre-registered with a public change log; the MAS is reported as built, with one validity bar unmet (its planner never saw the tool schemas). Under a fixed simulated user no cell shows a MAS benefit: the MAS is worse in 12 of the 13 valid cells and tied in the thirteenth, and the fitted gain is negative across the observed capability range (weighted mean -28 points, 95% CI [-44, -12]). On the two cells where the rule predicts a benefit, the MAS loses by 13 and 22 points, and without a budget ceiling it at best draws level at 5.5 times the SAS’s token spend. The one gain appears on the cell nearest 45%, under a second simulator. Whether the gain declines with capability is unresolved (slope -0.41, 95% CI [-1.51, +0.68]), because model-by-domain effects dominate. The MAS does not detectably reduce wrongful database writes; it converts other failures into budget exhaustion and inaction. For agents that serve people, the SAS is the default; a multi-agent design must show compute-matched evidence from the setting itself. We release all trajectories, ledgers, prompts and code.

[MA-7] Complete Street Design informed by Multi-Agent Simulation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前完整街道（Complete Street）设计主要依赖定性原则，难以应对多模式城市交通日益复杂化的挑战。其核心问题是缺乏一种能够定量评估不同街道设计方案在通行效率与交通安全之间权衡的系统性方法。解决方案的关键在于构建一个微观仿真框架，通过显式建模异质道路使用者（包括自动驾驶汽车、网联汽车、人工驾驶车辆、上下客服务及微出行用户）的行为，集成行为模型以刻画横向变道、停车操作、行人过街与违规穿行、共享车道中自行车与电动滑板车交互等复杂动态。安全性能采用基于碰撞物理的冲突严重度指标进行量化，结合遗传算法实现街道布局的优化。研究结果表明，专用自行车道虽可降低冲突严重度但会牺牲机动车通行能力；提高自动驾驶汽车渗透率有助于缓解交通波动并改善人车交互。该框架能高效识别出兼顾通行与安全的帕累托最优街道设计方案，其创新性在于将异质行为建模、基于物理的冲突评估、随机性能分析与设计优化整合于统一的定量评价体系中，为交通规划者提供可预测的虚拟测试平台，支持实施前对街道设计的量化评估与决策支持。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27509
作者: Sharika J. Hegde,Amirmohammad Khakpour,Pedram Beigi, Yu (Marco)Nie,Hani S. Mahmassani
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Under review for publication in Transportation Research Record (TRR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Objectives: Complete Street design is currently guided largely by qualitative principles despite the increasing complexity of multimodal urban traffic. This paper develops a microscopic simulation framework for quantitatively evaluating alternative street designs by explicitly representing heterogeneous road users, including Autonomous Vehicles (AVs), Connected Vehicles (CVs), Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) services, and micromobility users. The framework jointly evaluates mobility and safety within a unified testbed. Methods:The framework enriches microscopic simulation with behavioral models for heterogeneous road users. It explicitly captures lateral movements, parking maneuvers, pedestrian crossings and jaywalking, and shared-lane bicycle and scooter interactions. Safety is quantified using a conflict severity measure grounded in collision physics, while candidate street layouts are optimized using a genetic algorithm. Findings: Applied to a segment of Belmont Avenue in Chicago, Illinois, the framework shows that dedicated bicycle lanes reduce conflict severity at the expense of vehicular throughput. Increasing AV penetration mitigates congestion by reducing traffic shockwaves while improving interactions with pedestrians relative to CVs and HDVs. The optimization framework efficiently identifies Pareto-efficient street layouts that balance mobility and safety. Novelty: The proposed framework integrates heterogeneous behavioral modeling, physics-based conflict assessment, stochastic performance evaluation, and design optimization within a single quantitative framework for Complete Street design. Practical Applications: The framework provides transportation planners with a predictive virtual testbed for evaluating street designs and quantifying the tradeoff between mobility and safety before implementation.

[MA-8] Robot-Task Suitability in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Task Allocation IROS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决异构多机器人任务分配中机器人-任务适配度（suitability）评估标准不统一所带来的核心问题，即如何在不同定义下准确衡量个体机器人对候选任务的匹配程度。其解决方案的关键在于系统性地比较十种确定性方法与两种基于大语言模型（LLM-based）的变体，涵盖规则驱动、相似性度量、需求导向、模糊逻辑及语义分析等多种范式，并通过标准化的机器人与任务配置，评估各类方法在评分、排序、可行性判断及最优机器人选择上的表现差异。研究发现，即使在相同场景下，不同方法常产生显著分歧；通用相似性度量可能违背单向需求满足语境下的预期性质，而基于LLM的方法则引入额外的随机性与语言敏感性。因此，论文强调机器人-任务适配度应被视为一项明确的建模选择，其假设前提、鲁棒性以及决策层面的影响必须在任务分配前被充分考量。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27504
作者: Daniel Weiner,Raj Korpan
机构: The Graduate Center, City University of New York (CUNY)(城市大学纽约分校研究生院); Hunter College and The Graduate Center, City University of New York (CUNY)(亨特学院和城市大学纽约分校研究生院)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Accepted at Workshop on Foundation Models for Multi-Robot Systems (FM-MRS), IROS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Heterogeneous multi-robot task allocation depends on estimates of how suitable individual robots are for candidate tasks, yet suitability can be defined in substantially different ways. We compare ten deterministic methods and two LLM-based variants spanning rule-based, similarity-based, requirement-oriented, fuzzy, and semantic approaches. Using common robot and task profiles, we compare how the methods score and rank candidate robots, identify feasibility, and select a top robot, while examining how these outcomes change with team composition, scale, spatial context, capability uncertainty, and task representation. The methods frequently disagree despite operating on identical scenarios. Generic similarity measures can violate properties expected under a one-sided requirement-satisfaction interpretation of suitability, while LLM-based scoring introduces additional stochastic and linguistic sensitivity. These results show that robot–task suitability should be treated as an explicit modeling choice whose assumptions, robustness, and decision-level consequences should be considered before allocation.

[MA-9] WaveCommitments: Private and Verifiable Speech-Agent Marketplaces

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现代语音系统中自治语音代理（speech agents）在私密性约束下的资产交易难题，即卖家因隐私限制无法公开披露其持有的语音资产（如嵌入向量、频谱图或原始数据），而买家则无法对无法验证的资产进行合理定价。针对这一“估值与验证悖论”，论文提出了一种名为WaveCommitments的端到端解决方案，其核心在于将基于数据沙普利值（Data Shapley）的保密资产估值机制与多方多项式承诺（multivariate polynomial commitments）相结合，并运行于可信执行环境（Trusted Execution Environment, TEE）内。该方案支持选择性开示和防篡改溯源，能够在不泄露任何额外信息的前提下，证明交付资产与估值结果一致。实验表明，该方法在三个基准数据集及多种任务上，结合Whisper等先进编码器，可实现最优基准速度提升最高达20倍，同时证明文件大小减少高达39倍；此外，通过系统分析不同任务与编码器下说话者价值的动态变化，揭示了代理层面的市场定价机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26867
作者: Oguzhan Baser,Kaan Kale,Sriram Vishwanath,Sandeep Chinchali
机构: The University of Texas at Austin (德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校); Georgia Institute of Technology (佐治亚理工学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: 5 pages, 3 figures, under review for a conference

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modern speech systems are evolving into ecosystems of autonomous speech agents that speak together, negotiate, and trade assets such as embeddings, spectrograms, or raw data. In such markets, sellers cannot reveal assets for evaluation due to privacy constraints, and buyers cannot price what they cannot test. Thus, we open-source WaveCommitments, an end-to-end design that pairs confidential asset valuation via Data Shapley inside a trusted execution environment with multivariate polynomial commitments. It enables selective openings and tamper-evident provenance to prove that a delivered asset matches the valuation while hiding everything else. Our extensive experiments across three known datasets and various tasks with state-of-the-art encoders, including Whisper, reveal that we speed up the best benchmarks by up to 20x while reducing their proof sizes by up to 39x. We also systematically study how a speaker’s value shifts across tasks and encoders, revealing agent-level market prices.

[MA-10] Measuring Consensus in AI Agent Networks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在复杂协作任务中因信息分散与观点分歧导致的共识形成机制不明确的问题，尤其关注智能体在网络化环境下如何通过协商达成一致决策。其核心解决方案在于提出一个评估框架，将共识形成建模为智能体公开立场随时间演进并趋近共享区域的过程，以累积的通信历史作为上下文，量化分析立场轨迹、群体离散度以及公开信息表达内容。该框架的关键创新在于区分“智能体间的观点收敛”与“向完全信息解的逼近”，从而揭示决策准确性与有限分歧之间的关系，并通过两组案例研究（基于分布式事实的人员配置决策、需处理重复信息与合同取消的复杂决策）验证了分享解释可提升集体决策准确性，同时发现即使整体答案准确，仍可能存在持续性分歧。此外，通过成员变更实验进一步补充评估，强化了对信息可用性与决策质量之间关联性的理解。

作者: Jin Gao
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 4 pages. Accepted at the NANDA Workshop, IEEE TPS-ISA 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As AI agents become increasingly connected through networks and take on tasks that require negotiation and joint decision-making, a systematic approach is needed to assess how their views converge and what information supports their decisions. We present an evaluation framework that treats consensus formation as the evolution of publicly stated positions toward a shared region, using accumulated communication history as context. The framework tracks position trajectories, group dispersion, and information expressed in public messages. Two case studies examine staffing decisions based on distributed facts and decisions requiring agents to reconcile duplicate information and a cancelled contract. Results from 1,872 completed runs associate sharing explanations with more accurate group decisions, while the second task reveals persistent disagreement despite accurate aggregate answers. Membership-change experiments provide a complementary evaluation. By separating convergence among agents from progress toward a task’s full-information answer, the framework relates decision accuracy and bounded disagreement to the information available during the exchange.

[MA-11] Large Language Models for Agent -Based Modelling: Current and possible uses across the modelling cycle

【速读】：该论文旨在解决如何将大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）有效融入基于智能体的建模（Agent-based Modelling, ABM）流程中所面临的机遇与挑战。其核心问题在于，尽管LLMs在自然语言理解、文本生成、逻辑推理和信息提取等方面展现出强大能力，但其在ABM全周期（从问题定义、模型构建、仿真运行到结果文档化与传播）中的实际应用仍缺乏系统性评估与批判性反思。解决方案的关键在于以建模周期为框架，对LLMs在各阶段的应用潜力进行结构化分析，并保持批判性立场，识别其在提升建模效率与智能化水平的同时可能带来的可靠性、可解释性及伦理风险等问题，从而为未来人机协同的智能建模提供理论指导与实践路径。

Abstract:The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) with increasingly sophisticated natural language understanding and generative capabilities has sparked interest in the Agent-based Modelling (ABM) community. With their ability to summarize, generate, analyze, categorize, transcribe and translate text, answer questions, propose explanations, sustain dialogue, extract information from unstructured text, and perform logical reasoning and problem-solving tasks, LLMs have a good potential to contribute to the modelling process. After reviewing the current use of LLMs in ABM, this study reflects on the opportunities and challenges of the potential use of LLMs in ABM. It does so by following the modelling cycle, from problem formulation to documentation and communication of model results, and holding a critical stance.

[MA-12] GBClaw: An agent ic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在多晶材料中普遍存在的复杂一般性晶界（general grain boundaries, GBs）结构与变形机制研究中的瓶颈问题。由于其结构高度复杂且界面失配度大，传统实验与建模方法难以有效开展系统性研究，导致此类晶界长期处于研究空白状态。为此，本文提出GBClaw——一种面向晶界结构与变形行为的智能体式人工智能（agentic AI）框架，其核心创新在于构建了一个集成大型语言模型（LLMs）的模块化架构，包含协调器、专业化智能体、领域专用工具、仿真接口及分层记忆系统。通过动态重规划与迭代工作流优化，该框架实现了高通量模拟与靶向机理分析的有效衔接。在镍材料14个非对称倾斜晶界的案例研究中，GBClaw成功揭示了界面缺陷结构并识别出多种变形模式；对比有无次级晶界错配位错情况下的剪切强度差异，证实了缺陷层级结构在滑移阻力中的关键作用；进一步结合研究人员引导的后续计算，发现异常高的剪切抗力源于亚稳态晶界构型。本研究证明，将智能体式AI与领域专业知识深度融合，可有效打通高通量计算筛选与复杂材料界面深层物理理解之间的鸿沟。

机构: 未知

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. Through dynamic replanning and iterative workflow refinement, the framework effectively connects systematic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis. Applied to 14 general asymmetric tilt GBs in nickel, GBClaw characterized interfacial defect structures and identified diverse deformation modes across these incommensurate boundaries. Comparing boundary sliding with and without secondary GB misfit dislocations revealed substantial differences in shear strength, underscoring the critical role of defect hierarchies in sliding resistance. Furthermore, researcher-guided follow-up calculations traced an anomalously high shear resistance to metastable boundary structures. This work demonstrates that combining agentic AI with domain expertise bridges high-throughput computational screening with deep physical understanding of complex material interfaces.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer’s Disease, AD）自发言语识别中缺乏可解释性的问题，即仅依赖转录文本进行分类时无法明确揭示其决策所依据的视觉场景证据。其核心解决方案是提出NarraSpace框架，通过将词汇与语音时间戳关联至命名的图像元素，实现对预定义场景事件的语音片段检索，并构建叙事-空间描述符以量化事件覆盖度与时间组织结构。该方法利用冻结的语言模型对比AD患者与健康对照组在各事件上的文本表现，结合转录文本的意外性（surprisal）与覆盖度测量，同时保留原始语音记录，使每个事件评分可追溯至对应的源话语、语音区间及词汇匹配信息。在阿尔茨海默病自发言语识别基准测试的48名参与者测试集上，固定支持向量机分类器在50次随机种子下的平均准确率达80.88%±2.56%，概率平均值进一步提升至81.25%准确率和91.32%受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）。NarraSpace通过将语言模型的测量结果与原始语音证据建立显式且可审查的关联，显著增强了分类输入的可解释性，为临床医生提供基于量化摘要与原始语音证据相结合的辅助诊断支持。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28616
作者: Qingming Li,Ruiyan Sun,Satoshi Nakamura
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong Shenzhen(香港中文大学（深圳)）
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 30 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Picture-description dementia classification uses a shared visual scene, but a transcript-level prediction alone does not identify the scene evidence underlying its inputs. NarraSpace links words and speech times to named picture elements and retrieves utterances for predefined scene events. Narrative-spatial descriptors summarize coverage and temporal organization. A frozen language model contrasts each event’s text under examples from Alzheimer’s disease and healthy-control training participants, alongside transcript surprisal and coverage measurements. Retained source records link event scores to their source utterances, speech intervals, and lexical matches. On the official 48-participant test set of the Alzheimer’s Dementia Recognition through Spontaneous Speech benchmark, a fixed support vector classifier achieves 80.88%\pm2.56% mean accuracy over fifty seeds; averaged probabilities yield 81.25% accuracy and 91.32% area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. NarraSpace makes the construction of scene-linked classification inputs explicit and inspectable by connecting event-indexed language-model measurements to their source utterances, speech timing, and extraction records. Such source-linked measurements could support clinician review of picture descriptions by presenting quantitative summaries alongside the original speech evidence.

[NLP-1] Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言（特别是方言阿拉伯语）在数学推理任务中研究不足的问题。针对这一空白，研究提出首个手动构建的基准测试——DAR-MGSM（Dialectal Arabic Multilingual Grade School Math），用于评估方言阿拉伯语中的数学推理能力。其核心解决方案在于构建包含五个主要阿拉伯语方言及现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的多语言数学应用题数据集，并设计了两种平行版本：仅翻译版与文化本地化版。后者通过调整问题中的实体和参照物以适配地区文化背景，从而揭示文化语境对模型表现的影响。实验结果表明，尽管整体准确率相似，但模型在文化本地化版本上的内部推理路径存在显著差异，且阿拉伯语专用模型对本地化敏感性不一，凸显了语言变体与文化背景共同影响数学推理性能的关键因素。

机构: 未知

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mathematical reasoning remains underexplored for low-resource languages, including Dialectal Arabic. To bridge this gap, we introduce the DAR-MGSM (Dialectal Arabic Multilingual Grade School Math) Benchmark, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic. DAR-MGSM consists of math word problems (MWPs) requiring multi-step reasoning and covers five major Arabic dialects alongside Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). The benchmark comprises two parallel versions: translated-only and translated culturally localized. The latter version adapts entities and references to regional varieties. We evaluate eleven Arabic-centric and multilingual large language models on DAR-MGSM. The results show that the performance generally declines on the localized version, highlighting the challenges introduced by culturally grounded adaptations. However, the magnitude of this effect varies across models, with Arabic-centric models exhibiting different levels of sensitivity to localization. A mechanistic interpretability analysis shows that translated and localized variants of the same MWPs often induce distinct internal reasoning trajectories, even when aggregate accuracy remains similar. Overall, our results show that mathematical reasoning performance depends on both linguistic variety and cultural context.

[NLP-2] Capable Teacher Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agent ic On-Policy Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 中基于代理的在线策略蒸馏（Agentic On-Policy Distillation, OPD）方法中存在的“误差累积”问题，其核心挑战在于：尽管教师模型在学生偏离轨迹后仍能成功接管并完成任务，但学生在根据教师对每个 token 的评分进行训练时，却因缺乏对最终任务结果的全局视野而持续选择延迟性安全动作，导致任务失败。现有方法通常通过课程学习、教师引导转向或前缀重播等方式限制训练区域，但作者指出这种解释并不完整。其根本原因在于教师评分机制的“短视性”——即教师仅基于单个 token 进行评分，未能考虑整个对话或任务的最终结果，从而允许了本应被强化学习惩罚的拖延行为。为此，作者提出了从轨迹到评分器的蒸馏（Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation, R2S），其关键创新在于：首先从未经训练的学生中挖掘高分歧状态，随后由教师在这些状态下执行接管（takeover）并评估其成功率（如通过一致性或 LLM 判定的无奖励检查），再以这些接管后的轨迹为依据，对教师评分器进行微调，使其在学生与教师分道扬镳之后的所有助手 token 上输出更具结果导向的评分。该修复后的教师评分器作为唯一评分源应用于标准 OPD，无需任何任务奖励信号。实验表明，在三个环境、两个教师和四个学生组合下，R2S 在全部十二组配置中均优于当前最先进的三种 agentic OPD 方法，平均提升达 12.8 个成功率点。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28586
作者: Shu Zhao,Tan Yu
机构: NVIDIA(英伟达)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 17 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student’s mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher’s own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout-scorer gap. We propose Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S), which repairs the scorer before distillation by mining high-disagreement states from the untrained student, running teacher takeovers from them, keeping the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check such as consensus or an LLM judge, and fine-tuning the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen as the sole scorer for standard OPD, requiring no task reward during repair or training. Across three environments, two teachers and four students, R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve teacher-student-environment cells, by 12.8 success points on average over the best of them in each cell. Project page: this https URL.

[NLP-3] Cache Engineering for Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体在处理长轨迹任务时，因键值（Key-Value, KV）缓存的I/O与存储开销过大，以及轨迹长度超过模型最大上下文长度所导致的缓存管理难题。传统方法通过上下文工程对历史信息进行裁剪或摘要以压缩缓存，但此类操作会破坏已有缓存状态，引发昂贵的重新预填充（re-prefilling）开销，且过度压缩可能影响任务准确性。为此，本文提出“缓存工程”（Cache Engineering）新范式，其核心在于允许智能体直接控制活跃KV缓存，而无需修改轨迹内容或触发重预填充。具体而言，智能体可通过“drop”操作主动排除特定缓存项以避免未来注意力计算，通过“repos”操作调整保留键的位置编码，从而实现对缓存的精细化管理。研究进一步指出，历史依赖性（history dependence）是服务层面的关键挑战：相同标记序列在不同缓存操作序列下可能产生不同的缓存状态，使得传统的前缀匹配机制无法保证缓存复用的正确性。为此，作者设计了协同优化的AKV服务引擎，提供无状态接口兼容现有推理服务API，同时在内部高效管理有状态的缓存复用、驱逐与恢复。实验表明，采用工具响应滚动丢弃（rolling-drop）缓存策略相较传统阈值触发摘要方法，平均基准得分提升1.7分，平均成本降低27.7%；结合AKV引擎，输出吞吐量最高提升1.2倍，P95请求延迟加速1.5倍；递归自改进的缓存策略相比专家设计进一步降低7.1%成本。

作者: Tianyu Fu,Ruoxi Wang,Zihan Min,Zhongqi Ren,Zhihao Li,Tengxuan Liu,Shengxu Mu,Hanling Zhang,Yu Wang
机构: Tsinghua University(清华大学); The Chinese University of Hong Kong(香港中文大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM’s maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys’ position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at this https URL.

[NLP-4] Large Flow Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型在实现高效并行生成时面临的挑战，尤其是如何在保持高生成质量的前提下，突破传统自回归（Autoregressive, AR）模型的串行生成瓶颈，并克服离散扩散模型在训练效率与推理速度上的局限。现有方法在千亿参数规模下缺乏有效的连续流语言建模技术，而本研究提出Lafa（Large flow language model），一种可扩展至80亿参数的高效连续流语言模型。其核心解决方案在于设计了一种分块式连续流架构：前缀部分采用因果注意力以保留自回归建模能力，块内则采用双向、异步的连续流机制，从而在保持模型表达力的同时支持分块并行解码。该设计使得模型能够基于预训练的AR模型进行高效微调，并通过前缀缓存和分块并行推理实现快速生成。实验表明，仅使用不足300亿个词元即可在0.5B、7B和8B规模上完成训练，显著优于以往扩散模型的训练效率。在指令遵循、推理与代码生成任务中，Lafa的生成质量可媲美甚至超越自回归模型，且可通过流映射实现一步或少数几步生成。尤为关键的是，连续流训练通过多标记预测效应（multi-token prediction effect）不仅保留了预训练模型的能力，还进一步增强其性能，这一特性被用于构建一种自洽的推测性解码（self-speculative decoding）机制——在单个模型内部以自回归方式验证基于流生成的草稿，最终实现2.54倍于标准AR模型的吞吐量，同时保持相当的生成质量，显著优于多标记预测和离散扩散方法。研究表明，连续流架构可作为未来大模型语言建模的可扩展基础。

作者: Arnav Chavan,Chanhyuk Lee,Udbhav Bamba,Jaehoon Yoo,Seunghoon Hong,Aditi Raghunathan,Jinwoo Kim
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

Abstract:Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.

[NLP-5] Binary Discrete Diffusion: Candidate-Set Diffusion for Logic and Planning Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有离散扩散模型（discrete diffusion models）在处理序列生成任务时，因掩码（masked）和均匀（uniform）噪声机制导致单次扰动即抹除标记身份，无法显式表征多个候选解共存的局部不确定性问题。其核心解决方案是提出二值离散扩散（Binary Discrete Diffusion），通过将每个位置的噪声状态建模为一个由二值成员向量表示的候选标记集合，实现候选集的逐步增删操作。这一设计使得信息可渐进地丢失与恢复，同时噪声状态本身能够直接编码部分求解过程中的不确定性。实验表明，在数独难题（Sudoku-Extreme）、Boxoban 和图着色等高难度约束生成任务中，对称形式的二值扩散在相同架构、训练与采样预算下持续超越强基线模型，尤其在最复杂实例上表现更优；同时在语言建模任务（Text8、TinyStories、OpenWebText）上保持竞争力。结果验证了候选集作为迭代推理的有效中间表示，并揭示了前向腐蚀核（corruption kernel）对反向模型所学习计算的本质影响。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28543
作者: Rodrigo Casado Noguerales,Dimitri von Rütte,Bernhard Schölkopf,Thomas Hofmann,Aran Raoufi
机构: ETH Zurich(苏黎世联邦理工学院); Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems(马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所); ELLIS Institute Tübingen(ELLIS图宾根研究所)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
备注: 42 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token’s identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. On Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, and graph coloring, the symmetric formulation of binary diffusion consistently outperforms strong, well-tuned masked and uniform baselines under matched architectures and controlled training, sampling, and tuning budgets, with its largest gains on the hardest instances, while remaining competitive on language modeling (Text8, TinyStories, OpenWebText). These results support candidate sets as an effective intermediate representation for iterative reasoning and show that the corruption kernel can materially change the computation learned by the reverse model.

[NLP-6] BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决超低比特（ultra-low-bit）大语言模型（LLM）在高效部署过程中，如何与多标记预测（multi-token prediction, MTP）技术协同加速解码的问题。核心挑战在于：直接结合超低比特压缩与MTP方法时，由于掩码起草（masked drafting）缺乏后续标记训练所需的中间输入，以及更宽计算量和因果键值（KV）更新带来的开销，难以在保持相近生成质量的前提下实现有效加速。为此，本文提出了一种算法-系统协同设计框架BitMTP，其关键在于通过联合的下一标记预测与MTP目标，使单一模型同时具备自回归（AR）生成与块因果起草能力；采用仅基于置信度、仅推测性、混合解码等多种策略，在不依赖独立草稿模型与验证模型的情况下灵活调节质量与吞吐性能；引入已接受前缀对齐（accepted-prefix alignment）机制，确保提交前缀、因果KV边界及CUDA Graph重播状态的一致性，从而支持连续生成；并基于此契约，选择宽度专用的低比特执行路径，复用共享KV存储上的捕获图。实验表明，BitMTP在NVIDIA H20、RTX 3090及Jetson Orin等不同硬件上均实现了显著加速，相较基线模型在五任务平均速度上提升2.1–2.4倍，在MBPP+任务上最高达3.3倍，充分验证了其在多种模型规模与硬件平台下的通用性与高效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28500
作者: Ning Zhang,Shihao Wang,Jinrui Zhang,Chaodong Xiao,Lei Zhang
机构: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University(香港理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 16 pages, 3 figures. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at this https URL

[NLP-7] Present but Hard to Read: Probing Latent Reasoning with Minimal Pairs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型（Generative AI）中潜在推理过程的可探测性问题，即如何准确识别和验证模型内部状态是否包含未显式写出的中间计算结果（如两步问题中的中间值a+b）。传统探测方法通常仅在模型输出答案的起始阶段读取其状态，并将探测失败视为该信息不存在的证据，但这种方法可能因探测方式不当而产生误判。本文的关键解决方案是提出一种新的探测协议，结合合成零假设（synthetic null）以区分输入复制与输入混合所导致的信号，从而更可靠地检验模型内部是否存在被计算但未写入的中间值。实验表明，在循环模型Ouro-1.4B和标准Transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B中，尽管某个数字在输入中被复制并存在于最后一轮提示的隐藏状态中（读出置信度约0.9），但在逐次单个提示探测的常规设置下，该信号几乎无法被捕捉（Ouro为0.36，Qwen为0.19），说明探测效率受上下文分布影响显著。进一步分析发现，该数字的变化是微弱而非密集的，其方向上的扰动远小于随机替换单词所带来的状态偏移，且由于所有变化都留下痕迹，成功探测本身也具有歧义性。在预注册的双步问题研究中，该协议检测到在模型书写答案最后一位数字前存在微弱的中间值信号，且其符号与运算类型一致，但部分符号相关性可能源于输入混合效应。更重要的是，若将中间值固定于第一轮循环的另一问题中，该值虽可读却不会影响当前问题的答案书写，证明其虽存在于状态中但未被实际使用，揭示了“可读”与“可利用”之间的关键区别。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28498
作者: Aur Shalev Merin
机构: Independent researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Probing studies of latent reasoning often read a model’s state where the answer begins and take a failed probe as evidence that a value is absent. We test this with a digit copied from the question, in the looped model Ouro-1.4B and the standard transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B. Comparing prompts that differ only in that digit shows it is present at the last prompt token, in a code shared across questions (readout about 0.9). A probe that sees one prompt at a time, the usual setting, barely reads it: 0.36 in Ouro and 0.19 in Qwen even after 5,249 training questions. The digit’s change is small rather than crowded: random noise lands on equally busy directions, while a random word in its place moves the state far more and is readable. Since every varied token leaves a trace, a successful probe is ambiguous too. We give a protocol, including a synthetic null for generic mixing, for testing computed values against copies and mixtures of the inputs. In pre-registered studies of two-step problems it finds a small signal for the unwritten intermediate a+b just before Ouro writes the answer’s last digit, and its sign follows the operation, though mixing alone produces much of that sign-following part. Holding that value at another problem’s from the first loop on does not move the written digit toward the other problem’s, while the same patch of the answer does: the value is readable but not used.

[NLP-8] OptionWorld: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Failures of LLM s as Long-Term Personal Assistants

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）作为长期个人助理在跨日任务中因信息持续变化而难以有效追踪和完成任务的问题。当前的系统虽能执行信息获取或启动操作，但无法确保任务最终完成，其核心缺陷在于缺乏对任务状态的持续维护能力。解决方案的关键在于构建名为OptionWorld的基准测试框架，通过模拟日常生活中的任务流程，系统性地追踪信息获取、判断、行动及结果，从而揭示现有模型在任务延续性方面的三大主要问题：所需信息未能被获取或整合、可用行动机会被忽略、以及代理自身施加了任务本身并不要求的限制。实验进一步表明，补充缺失信息可恢复部分任务成功率；行动提醒可重启中断的工作，但后续步骤仍可能错过截止时间；修正错误的禁止性注释则能恢复合法的查询权限。这些发现明确了当前模型在保持任务状态方面的能力短板，即如何将事实与未完成工作关联、在截止前持续推进任务，以及区分真实约束与代理的主观假设。

作者: Ruoyu Zhang,Zhaocen Liu,Weiyi Tian,Melissa Feng,Shilong Liu
机构: University of British Columbia (不列颠哥伦比亚大学); University of Chicago (芝加哥大学); Princeton University (普林斯顿大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 31 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-term assistants must follow unfinished tasks across days as information and circumstances change. Finding information or starting an action, however, does not ensure that the task gets completed. We introduce OptionWorld, a benchmark that traces information acquisition, judgments, actions, and outcomes in simulated daily-life tasks to identify where current LLMs fall short as long-term personal assistants. In runs with archived decision inputs, the key facts remain in the model’s last input before the deadline in 35.5% of failed instances. Failure analysis identifies the three most frequent problems: needed information is not obtained or combined, available opportunities to act go unused, and agents impose restrictions that the task does not require. Three follow-up experiments show that supplying missing facts restores task success in some cases; action reminders can restart work while subsequent steps still miss the deadline; and correcting a supplied note that wrongly forbids contact restores permitted inquiry. These findings locate shortcomings in maintaining task state: connecting facts to unfinished work, following through before deadlines, and separating actual restrictions from the agent’s assumptions.

[NLP-9] Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决循环变压器（Looped Transformer）在深度扩展过程中，因上下文构建与状态迭代优化在同一递归计算中耦合而导致的表征能力受限问题。其核心挑战在于：传统全栈循环架构未能显式区分“一次性上下文编码”与“迭代状态精炼”的不同功能角色，从而限制了模型对长期依赖和动态推理的建模能力。为此，论文提出非对称循环变压器（Asymmetric Looped Transformer, AsymLoop），其关键创新在于将模型结构解耦为两个独立模块：一个单次前向传播的因果编码器（causal encoder），负责生成各层固定的全局键值（Global KV）缓存；以及一个权重共享的递归解码器（recurrent decoder），基于自身演化状态动态生成局部键值（Local KV）。通过在单一softmax下联合注意力机制融合全局上下文与局部状态信息，实现持久上下文与当前中间状态的高效交互。此外，采用重尾引导的分层学习率策略分别优化编码器与解码器。实验表明，在相同有效深度与训练令牌预算下，AsymLoop在四个规模（60M–1B）的FineWeb-Edu数据集上均取得更低的验证困惑度和更高的下游平均准确率；在1B规模下，零样本常识推理任务平均准确率从49.58%提升至50.85%，并进一步在更长训练周期、OLMo型骨干网络及稀疏专家混合（sparse mixture-of-experts）模型中验证了该设计的普适性与有效性。结果表明，非对称的上下文编码与状态精炼分离机制是提升递归语言模型性能的有效架构范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28489
作者: Cheng Liang,Tengfei Zhang,Wenjie DU,Jianyu Wu,Changlian Ma,Shuchen Pu,Ya Zhang,Yanfeng Wang,Zhouhan Lin
机构: Shanghai Jiaotong University (上海交通大学); University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学); Nanyang Technological University (南洋理工大学); Nanjing University (南京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. For training, we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. Experiments on FineWeb-Edu across four model scales, from 60M to 1B, show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than Full Loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. At 1B, AsymLoop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. Further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets, an OLMo-style backbone, and sparse mixture-of-experts models. These results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.

[NLP-10] GPT -6-Astra Understands Touch and Outperform Vision–Tactile–Language–Action Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决通用多模态模型在机器人操作中对真实世界物理交互本质的理解不足，以及如何利用这种理解来指导动作决策的问题。其核心挑战在于接触丰富的操作任务中，机器人需基于触觉反馈进行感知与动作调整，而现有方法依赖特定预训练和任务级微调，导致数据与训练成本高昂。解决方案的关键在于提出GPT-as-Tactile-Policy框架，将专家示范总结为任务指引与触觉参考，用于接触评估与纠正动作；结合多模态观测与交互历史，通过GPT-6-Astra模型生成控制指令并实时响应触觉反馈，实现无需额外机器人专用预训练或任务微调的端到端控制。实验表明，该方法在五个UniVTAC任务上平均成功率达93.8%，尤其在“插入孔洞”任务中成功率从31%提升至99%，验证了触觉反馈驱动的探测与修正机制的有效性，充分体现了基于专家经验与在线反馈的接触引导式操作能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28457
作者: Ziyong Wang,Yupei Lin,Runxuan Huang,Liang Lin,Dongyu Zhang,Guangrun Wang
机构: Sun Yat-sen University (中山大学); X-Era AI Lab; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (香港理工大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:General-purpose multimodal models have shown promise as direct robot action policies, yet whether they grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions and can apply that understanding to guide action remains underexplored. We investigate this question using contact-rich manipulation as a representative testbed, examining tactile understanding as a concrete instance of this broader capability. Contact-rich manipulation requires interpreting tactile feedback and adjusting actions after obstruction. Existing learned tactile policies acquire these capabilities through specialized pretraining and per-task optimization, with substantial data and training costs. We present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which summarizes expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references for contact assessment and corrective action. GPT-6-Astra combines this context with multimodal observations and interaction history to generate control commands and adjust actions through contact feedback. Without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, our method achieves 93.8% mean success across five UniVTAC tasks. Overall performance is comparable to state-of-the-art policies, with higher success on selected tasks. On Insert Hole, tactile feedback improves success from 31% to 99%. Execution analysis further demonstrates contact-guided probing and correction, supporting manipulation progress through explicit expert experience and online feedback.

[NLP-11] MythoSemantic: An Interactive System for Discovering Semantic Parallels Across Mythological and Religious Traditions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决神话与宗教文本跨文化比较研究中传统人工分析方法劳动强度大、难以规模化的问题。其核心解决方案是利用神经语言模型将不同文化的文本嵌入到共享的语义空间中，使用户能够在交互式界面中高效识别跨文化传统间的语义相似性。该方法的关键在于通过语义嵌入揭示文本片段在宏观上与已知历史关联相符的语义结构，并量化词汇重叠与专有名词在解释这些结构几何特征中的贡献程度，从而为跨文化文本比较提供可计算、可量化的分析框架。

Abstract:We present a tool for the comparative study of mythological and religious texts. Traditional manual analysis is highly labor-intensive and difficult to scale. To address this, we use neural language models to embed texts into a shared semantic space, so that users can find semantic parallels across cultural traditions in an interactive interface. Embedded fragments form distinct semantic structures whose coarse geometry aligns with well-documented historical relations between traditions. We quantify how much of that geometry is already explained by lexical overlap and by proper names. The current system is available at this https URL, and the installable package is available at this https URL.

[NLP-12] Every Model Leaves a Trace: Multi-Resolution LLM Fingerprinting

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）模型在生成文本中留下的模型特异性痕迹（fingerprint）的可分辨性问题，特别是当明显特征被削弱时，这些痕迹仍能在多大程度上区分相关模型。其核心解决方案在于系统性地评估指纹在不同层次上的分辨率，涵盖模型层面（如不同模型家族、蒸馏模型及微调变体）和信号层面（行为特征、风格特征、词汇特征与语义证据）。研究通过逐步抑制表面提示、改写输出内容、调整文本量，并测试跨提示分布与跨语言场景下的泛化能力，发现即使在去除显性线索后，模型特异性信号依然存在，且在蒸馏模型甚至同一基础模型的LoRA适配版本中仍可检测。其中，语义表征在跨语言情境下表现出最强鲁棒性，表明模型身份信息可在多种粒度下被恢复，但其可恢复性取决于模型间的相似度以及文本中可用的证据类型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28434
作者: Mohammad Reza Modarres,Armin Tourajmehr,Artin Tavasoli,Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh,Mohammad Taher Pilehvar
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models leave model-specific traces in their generated text, but it remains unclear how finely these fingerprints can distinguish related models and which signals remain informative as obvious cues are reduced. We study this through fingerprint resolution, considering both model resolution, from different families to distilled and adapted variants, and signal resolution across behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic evidence. We progressively suppress surface cues, paraphrase outputs, vary the amount of available text, and test generalization across prompt distributions and languages. Our results show that fingerprints persist beyond broad family differences, remaining detectable in distilled models and even LoRA adaptations of the same base model. Although attribution weakens as surface and lexical cues are altered, substantial model-specific signal remains. These signals transfer across prompt sources and languages, with semantic representations proving most robust across languages. These findings show that model identity is recoverable at multiple resolutions, but that recoverability depends on model similarity and the evidence available in the text.

[NLP-13] he Instruction Tax on Factual Recall: Base Models Can Beat Their Instruction-Tuned Counterparts

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自动知识库构建（AKBC）语言模型知识三元组抽取（LM-KBC）2026共享任务中，如何在不使用检索或微调的前提下，仅通过提示工程（prompting）从大规模语言模型（LLM）中高效生成高准确率的主体-关系对所有可能对象的问题。其核心挑战在于，在无外部知识增强与模型参数更新的情况下，如何最大化模型的常识推理能力与事实召回率。解决方案的关键在于发现并规避“指令调优副作用”（instruction tax），即尽管指令调优版本在对话接口下表现良好（得分0.5681），但其权重导致事实召回率下降；而采用基础模型（base model）配合文本补全式提示（text completion prompting）可实现更高性能（0.6836）。最终方案简洁有效：利用训练数据中的若干示例进行提示，生成64至256个候选输出，并保留重复出现的结果以提升可靠性；此外，针对不同关系类型设计了两个专项策略：一是优化大规模答案集的召回率，二是通过判断人物生存状态来提升死亡地点预测的准确性。该方法凸显了提示工程设计对模型表现的决定性影响，超越了模型架构本身的重要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28407
作者: Christophe Khalil,Aya Mourad
机构: American University of Beirut(贝鲁特美国大学); Sorbonne Université(索邦大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present our solution to the AKBC LM-KBC 2026 Shared Task, where we achieved a score of 0.6836 on the official leaderboard, more than double the baseline of 0.2964. This task requires generating all possible objects for subject-relation pairs using a language model with up to 32 billion parameters, with no retrieval or fine-tuning involved. We show that the prompting methodology is as important as the model architecture: while the instruction-tuned model version achieves 0.5681 with its chat interface, the base model achieves 0.6836 when prompted using text completion. Thus, instruction tuning decreases factual recall; we refer to this effect as the instruction tax, which is caused by the model’s weights rather than the prompting method. Our final solution is fairly straightforward: we prompt the base model with some examples from the training data, generate 64–256 outputs, and retain only the repeated ones. Two specialized methods are then applied for each relation: one improves the recall of large answer sets, and the other verifies a person’s vitality before predicting their place of death.

[NLP-14] MAS-Guard: Unified Guardrails from Individual Agents to Multi-Agent LLM Systems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在单智能体与多智能体系统中因自主规划与执行复杂工作流而引发的安全风险，包括不安全行为、信息泄露及对抗性攻击等问题。尤其在多智能体系统中，由于角色异构、权限分散以及部分参与者不可信或行为不透明，传统防护手段难以实现全面覆盖。现有防御机制通常仅针对单一威胁场景，缺乏对本地执行、系统级交互与执行控制机制的统一保障。为此，本文提出MAS-Guard——一个面向包含可编程与非可编程智能体的单/多智能体应用的统一安全框架。其核心在于构建分层协同的防护机制：在本地层面，通过“代理护栏”（Agent Guardrail, A-Guard）引入任务特定专家模型，对智能体事件进行动态评估；在系统层面，结合开发者掌控的“代理宪章”（Agent Charters）与控制平面（Control Plane），实现对路径结构、代理能力、消息格式等的确定性校验，以及对角色语义和消息内容的语义分析。两层机制共同支持“允许、反思、确认、阻断”四类统一干预策略，形成闭环管控。实验在六个涵盖多样化场景的基准上验证了该框架的有效性，结果表明相较于未受保护的智能体，MAS-Guard使攻击成功率降低71.5%至86.3%，同时在良性任务上保持了可接受的实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28397
作者: Mohammad Kachuee,Phu Mon Htut,Sheng Li,Nikolaos Pappas,Miguel Ballesteros Martinez,Yassine Benajiba,Sujith Ravi,Dan Roth
机构: Oracle AI
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic AI extends large language models (LLMs) from generating responses to planning and executing complex workflows, substantially expanding their utility while exposing applications to unsafe actions, information leakage, and adversarial manipulation. Multi-agent systems further expand these capabilities through specialization and collaboration, but distributed authority, heterogeneous roles, and opaque or potentially compromised participants make safeguarding even more challenging. Existing defenses address important individual threats but provide fragmented coverage across local execution, system-level interactions, and enforcement mechanisms. We introduce MAS-Guard, a unified framework that closes this gap for safeguarding single- and multi-agent AI applications containing both instrumentable and opaque agents. Within instrumentable agents, the proposed local Agent Guardrail (A-Guard) layer applies task-specific experts to assess agentic events. At the system level, developer-owned Agent Charters and a Control Plane combine deterministic structural checks of routes, agent capabilities, and message formats with semantic assessments of roles and message content. These complementary layers enable enforcement through a shared set of interventions: allow, reflection, confirmation, and block. Evaluated across six benchmarks covering diverse single- and multi-agent scenarios with three agent LLMs from different providers, MAS-Guard reduces the overall attack success rate by 71.5-86.3% relative to unguarded agents, while meeting the utility reference criterion on benign tasks.

[NLP-15] When Copying Is Hard: Copy-Constrained Decoding for Exact Span Reproduction NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在长上下文环境中精确复现目标文本片段（exact span reproduction）的能力不足问题，尤其当目标字符串存在于上下文但模型仍出现内容偏移或无法正确终止时，暴露出源信息锚定（source grounding）与边界控制（boundary control）的缺陷。这一能力在代码生成等实际场景中至关重要，例如需原样嵌入API密钥等敏感字符串。其解决方案的关键在于提出CopyGen——一种针对冻结的预训练大模型设计的轻量级复制约束插件，将原本作为下一个词预测副产品的复制行为转变为可控制的解码过程。核心思想是将复制行为分解为三个独立决策：何时进入复制模式、复制长度的预判以及逐标记验证以决定停止时机。具体实现上，CopyGen首先判断是否进入复制模式，随后预测一个试探性复制长度，并通过自适应调整复制延续标记的对数几率（logits）进行逐标记验证，仅输出最长的有效前缀。实验表明，CopyGen在三种主流大模型架构和四项基准任务上，无需微调即可使平均精确匹配率提升35%相对性能，结合监督微调（SFT）进一步提升4%，同时显著加速生成过程。结果表明，可靠的精确复制并非模型固有属性，而是一个需要显式建模的解码阶段控制问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28393
作者: Jinghui Zhang,Lang Gao,Zongfang Liu,Ruihong Zeng,Zirui Song,Rui Yan,Kentaro Inui,Xiuying Chen
机构: MBZUAI(中东人工智能大学); Zhejiang University(浙江大学); Westlake University(西湖大学); Wuhan University(武汉大学); Wuhan Textile University(武汉纺织大学); Tohoku University(东北大学); RIKEN(理化学研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Precisely reproducing a target span verbatim within a long context is a fundamental capability test for LLMs: even when the target string is present in context, models often still drift within the span or fail to stop correctly, revealing limitations in source grounding and boundary control. This capability has broad practical relevance. For instance, code generation often requires embedding sensitive strings such as API keys exactly as they appear in context. In this work, we construct a benchmark to test exact span reproduction ability across contracts, scientific literature, code, and random sequences, and find that current models still make surprisingly frequent errors. To address this, we propose CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs that turns copying from a byproduct of next-token prediction into a controlled process. Our key idea is to decompose copying into three distinct decisions: when to copy, how far to copy, and when to stop. Concretely, CopyGen first determines whether to enter copy mode, then predicts a tentative copy length, and finally verifies the generated span token by token. During verification, we adaptively adjust the logits of copy continuation tokens to incentivize or suppress continuation, and emit only the longest valid prefix. Across three LLM backbones and four benchmark tasks, CopyGen improves average exact match by 35% relative without model finetuning, and integrates seamlessly with SFT to further improve it by 4%, while substantially accelerating generation. These results suggest that reliable exact copying is not something LLMs obtain for free, but a decoding-time control problem that requires explicit modeling. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-16] CAPSafe: A Benchmark for Contextual Action and Plan Safety Reasoning in Embodied Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的具身智能体在复杂家庭场景中进行安全推理的能力不足问题，尤其关注其在长时序动作规划中的安全性。其核心挑战在于：现有模型虽能较好识别单一动作的安全性（如根据物体属性推断潜在风险），但在面对多风险共存、情境依赖性强且需长期规划的任务时，难以生成连贯且安全的行动序列。解决方案的关键是构建一个双层级的安全评估基准——上下文动作与计划安全基准（CAPSafe），该基准包含两个层面：一是针对单个动作在特定环境上下文中是否安全的评估，二是对智能体完成复杂高危家庭任务时生成长时序计划的安全性评估。该基准特别强调情境性危险（由对象属性推断）、多重危险共现以及按相对严重程度标注的细粒度分析能力，从而系统揭示了当前主流闭源与开源大模型在从短时安全判断到长时安全规划之间的显著能力鸿沟。实验表明，尽管部分模型在单步动作安全识别上表现优异（最高超90%准确率），但在长时序规划中仍存在明显短板，仅有Gemini-3-pro达到78.19%的安全成功率，其余模型普遍低于65%，凸显出鲁棒性长序列安全推理仍是亟待突破的核心难题。

作者: Youmna Farag,Svetlana Stoyanchev,Simon Keizer,Mohan Li,Rama Doddipatla
机构: Cambridge Research Laboratory, Toshiba Europe Ltd(剑桥研究中心，东芝欧洲有限公司), UK(英国)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
